//_room: Room code this bot connects to -- must be unique across the manifest.
//_envFile: Path (relative to the repo root, or absolute) to a .env-style file for this bot -- same format as the repo's own .env. Omit to just inherit this process's own environment. STATUS_PORT and ROOM in the file are ignored: the manager assigns those (ROOM from this entry's "room", STATUS_PORT sequentially from BASE_BOT_STATUS_PORT, or from an explicit "statusPort" below).
